tools.name: list_commits
tools.description: List the commits to a GitLab project since a time, newest first, optionally only those on a branch or that touch a path. Returns each commit's SHA, message, author, date and link.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

path.description: Only commits that touch this file or directory, for example deploy/values.yaml.

project.description: The project's full path, for example acme/checkout or acme/platform/checkout. Give project or service, not both.

ref.description: The branch, tag or SHA to list from. Default: the default branch.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its project in its own settings. Give project or service, not both.

since.description: Only commits made at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

until.description: Only commits made before this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

tools.name: get_commit
tools.description: Get one commit of a GitLab project: its message, author, date, parents, the files it changed with line counts, and the patch of each file, cut when the commit is large.

project.description: The project's full path, for example acme/checkout or acme/platform/checkout. Give project or service, not both.

ref.description: The commit SHA, or a branch or tag to get its latest commit.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its project in its own settings. Give project or service, not both.

tools.name: list_merge_requests
tools.description: List the merge requests of a GitLab project that were opened or merged since a time, most recently updated first, with their state, branches, author, times, merge commit and link.

base.description: Only merge requests into this target branch, for example main.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

project.description: The project's full path, for example acme/checkout or acme/platform/checkout. Give project or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its project in its own settings. Give project or service, not both.

since.description: Only merge requests opened or merged at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

tools.name: list_releases
tools.description: List the releases of a GitLab project, newest first, with tag, name, dates and link. With includeTags, also list the newest tags and the commit each points at.

includeTags.description: Also list the newest tags. Default false.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

project.description: The project's full path, for example acme/checkout or acme/platform/checkout. Give project or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its project in its own settings. Give project or service, not both.

since.description: Only releases made at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

tools.name: list_pipelines
tools.description: List the pipelines of a GitLab project, newest first, for example to see what ran after a merge: status, source, ref, commit, times and link.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

project.description: The project's full path, for example acme/checkout or acme/platform/checkout. Give project or service, not both.

ref.description: Only pipelines for this branch or tag.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its project in its own settings. Give project or service, not both.

since.description: Only pipelines created at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.

source.description: Only pipelines started by this source, such as push, web, schedule or merge_request_event.

tools.name: get_file
tools.description: Read a file of a GitLab project at a ref, or list a directory. Files over 256 KiB are cut, and binary files are not shown.

path.description: The file or directory, relative to the project root, for example deploy/values.yaml.

project.description: The project's full path, for example acme/checkout or acme/platform/checkout. Give project or service, not both.

ref.description: The branch, tag or commit SHA to read at. Default: the default branch.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its project in its own settings. Give project or service, not both.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Compare two refs of a GitLab project, base...head: the newest commits of head that base lacks, and the files changed with line counts.

base.description: The older branch, tag or SHA, for example the tag of the last good release.

head.description: The newer branch, tag or SHA.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

project.description: The project's full path, for example acme/checkout or acme/platform/checkout. Give project or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its project in its own settings. Give project or service, not both.

tools.name: list_deployments
tools.description: List the deployments of a GitLab project, newest first, optionally of one environment: status, ref, commit, who deployed, times and link. Use it to see what was deployed when.

environment.description: Only deployments to the environment with this name, for example production.

limit.description: The most items to return, 1 to 100. Default 30.

project.description: The project's full path, for example acme/checkout or acme/platform/checkout. Give project or service, not both.

service.description: A service name, such as the service an alert names; Sidekick looks up its project in its own settings. Give project or service, not both.

since.description: Only deployments created at or after this time, in RFC 3339 form, for example 2026-05-04T10:00:00Z.
